Aria: Heads-up team  Cygnus AI just converted their pilot into a 12-month Dedicated contract via DataBridge co-sell. Pilot -> GA this morning. Big cross-functional win! :tada:

Ben: Nice! ACV $395k, billing starts next month. They shipped a realtime matching feature after the pilot. Who owns the case study + partner tile?

Samir: Eng pilot notes: deployed `redwood deploy --env dedicated --region ap-southeast-1 --pool dedicated-ap-2` with dynamic batching, per-customer KV sharding, and mixed-precision quantization. Steady-state: 160 QPS, p95 ~58ms for 300 tokens, cost per infer down ~43% vs baseline. We have perf dashboards to attach.

Lola: Marketing will own the one-pager and DataBridge marketplace tile. @Aria can you share customer contact + a short quote? Also ask for logo permission and a 20s CTO clip.

Aria: Contact: Theo Marin, Head of ML  theo@cygnus.ai. Customer-approved line: "Redwood Dedicated via DataBridge let us hit production latency targets and cut inference costs so we could ship realtime matching." Feel free to edit.

Ben: Sales note: they exercised two burst credits during BlackFriday-like sim; contract doesn't include burst credits for GA. Need to confirm whether to include a mention in the case study.

Samir: Quick tech caveat: Cygnus uses a light-weight byte-pair tokenizer variant that increases token counts by ~7% vs our default we'll flag that in the reproducibility notes. Also: they used a small in-house preprocessor which reduced seq len by ~10% for most requests.

Hiro (Legal): Need signed logo + testimonial release. DataBridge has a marketplace co-sell addendum we need to sign; I'll draft the addendum and the release form.

Lola: Proposed timeline: draft assets by Thu, Legal review Fri, customer review early next week, publish DataBridge tile + blog post two weeks after sign-off. I'll coordinate with Partner Comms for co-branded copy.

Aria: Ops checklist: 1) Legal/Partners sync (Hiro) 2) Eng to upload perf dashboards + config snippets (Samir) 3) Sales to confirm PO and whether to mention burst credits (Ben) 4) Marketing to draft assets (Lola). I'll send invites.

Ben: Fantastic work all. We'll hold the company-wide shout until Legal and DataBridge approve the copy. :rocket:
